"name": "Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor"}, {"cwe_id": "CWE-349", "name": "Acceptance of Extraneous Untrusted Data With Trusted Data"}], "description": "### Impact

wlc could send an unscoped API token to an unintended server when run inside a directory tree containing attacker-controlled project configuration.

If `.weblate`, `.weblate.ini`, or `weblate.ini` defines an API url, and the user supplies a token with `WLC_KEY` or `--key` without also pinning the URL, wlc would send the token to the project-configured URL.

Impacted users are those running wlc in untrusted repositories, pull request checkouts, or directories with untrusted ancestor configuration while using `WLC_KEY` or `--key`.

### Patches

The issue is patched in wlc 2.0.1 via https://github.com/WeblateOrg/wlc/pull/1500.

The fix rejects unscoped keys when the API URL comes from automatically discovered project configuration:

- `WLC_KEY` now requires `WLC_URL`.
- `--key` now requires `--url`.
- URL-scoped keys in the `[keys]` configuration section remain supported.

Users should upgrade to wlc 2.0.1 or newer.

### Workarounds

Without upgrading, users can avoid the issue by explicitly pinning the API URL whenever using an unscoped key:

`WLC_URL=https://hosted.weblate.org/api/ WLC_KEY=... wlc ...`

or:

`wlc --url https://hosted.weblate.org/api/ --key ... ...`

Alternatively, use URL-scoped keys in the [keys] section instead of WLC_KEY or --key, and avoid running wlc with secrets in untrusted checkouts.

- The issue was independently reported by [type5afe](https://hackerone.com/type5afe) and [visionx7](https://hackerone.com/visionx7) using HackerOne.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-3mqq-hv9c-85hc", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-22T20:34:07Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3mqq-hv9c-85hc", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-3mqq-hv9c-85hc"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-62364"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-09-22T20:34:07Z", "references": ["https://github.com/WeblateOrg/wlc/security/advisories/GHSA-3mqq-hv9c-85hc", "https://github.com/WeblateOrg/wlc/pull/1500", "https://github.com/WeblateOrg/wlc/commit/15cbdfc5b2c6183ef6864ea758091643a0ce6c89", "https://github.com/WeblateOrg/wlc/releases/tag/2.0.1", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3mqq-hv9c-85hc"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/WeblateOrg/wlc/security-advisories/GHSA-3mqq-hv9c-85hc", "severity": "low", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/WeblateOrg/wlc", "summary": "wlc may disclose API tokens to project-configured URLs", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-22T20:34:09Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-3mqq-hv9c-85hc", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "2.0.1", "package": {"ecosystem": "pip", "name": "wlc"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 2.0.1"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
